newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF shares rise 4 pct on '96 results.
newsitem.headline: SKF shares rise 4 pct on '96 results.

text.p: Shares in Swedish roller bearing maker SKF AB rose over four percent on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Thursday on the company's 1996 results.
"The profit was in line with expectations or somewhat better so players who had speculated in lower figures and sold shares ahead of the report are now buying," said a trader with a Stockholm bank.
At 1415 GMT, the share was up seven crowns at 172, while the exchange's general index was down 0.2 percent at 2,548.57.
For 1996, SKF reported a profit after financial items of 2.41 billion crowns.
A Reuter poll found profit expectations ranged between 2.22 billion and 2.69 billion crowns.
